description:
Log in to Moodle as admin (username: admin, password: Admin1234!) at http://localhost/moodle.

Navigate to the course "Computer Science Fundamentals" (CS110). Create a Choice (poll) activity to survey students about their preferred programming language:

1. Turn editing on for the course.
2. Add a new "Choice" activity with the following settings:
   - Activity name: "Preferred Programming Language"
   - Description: "Choose your preferred programming language for the course project. This will help us form balanced project teams."
   - Option 1: "Python"
   - Option 2: "Java"
   - Option 3: "C++"
   - Option 4: "JavaScript"
3. Under Availability settings:
   - Allow choice to be updated: Yes
4. Under Results settings:
   - Publish results: Always show results to students
5. Save and return to course.

The poll should appear as a new activity in the CS110 course page.
